'''Infrabinoculars''' were a device similar to [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macro-]] and [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]]. Designed to enhance awareness in urban environments, infrabinoculars picked up heat signatures instead of enhancing vision. High-powered versions could detect heat through shielded walls and other barriers up to two meters thick.<ref name="EV" />
